words.zh: n. 逆境，困境，不幸，灾难
words.example: Their friendship grew stronger through every adversity they faced together.

words.zh: n. 工资，薪水；  vt. 开展，进行（战争、运动）
words.example: They had to wage a fierce battle against the harsh Antarctic weather.

words.zh: adj. 味苦的；带来痛苦的；厉害的；激烈而不愉快的；严寒的；痛苦的，尖刻的，充满仇恨的；愤愤不平的；  v. 使变苦；  n. 苦；苦味物；苦啤酒；【航】系缆柱上的一圈缆索
words.example: The bitter wind made the long journey across the ice even harder.

words.zh: n. 远征队，探险队；探险；远征；短途旅行；迅速
words.example: The expedition to the South Pole required months of careful preparation.

words.zh: n. 忍耐力，耐性，耐用度；耐久力
words.example: The extreme cold tested the endurance of every member of the team.

words.zh: n. 活力；精力，力量
words.example: The young volunteers worked with great vigour to clean up the beach.

words.zh: phr. 拒绝(某人)
words.example: She turned him down when he asked her to join the expedition.

words.zh: adj. 有资格的；保留的；有限度的；具备……的知识（或技能、学历等）；合格的，胜任的；【计】修饰的；  vt. 描述；使合适；授权予；有权，达标；  vi. 合格；取得…的资格
words.example: After years of training, he felt qualified to lead the expedition.

words.zh: adj. 狂热的，极感兴趣的；热情的；热心的；热情洋溢、充满动力
words.example: The students were enthusiastic about joining the environmental protection club.

words.zh: adv. 在（交通工具）上；上（交通工具）；上船（或飞机、公共汽车、火车等）；  prep. 在（交通工具）上；上（交通工具）
words.example: All the passengers were safely aboard the ship before it left the harbour.

words.zh: n. 碗橱，衣柜；壁橱；橱柜，衣柜；食物柜
words.example: He found the old map in the cupboard behind the boxes.

words.zh: v. 布置；分配；分派；指定；归因；确定；给予；指派，选派；【法】转让
words.example: The teacher will assign each student a role in the rescue exercise.

words.zh: n. 乘务员，服务员；管家
words.example: The steward helped the passengers find their life jackets during the voyage.

words.zh: n. 羡慕；妒忌；妒忌的对象；令人羡慕的事或东西；  v. 羡慕；嫉妒
words.example: Her courage in the face of danger filled the others with envy.

words.zh: v. 【化】粉碎，破碎；  vi. 被压坏；被揉皱；蜂拥而来；  vt. 压扁，压坏；镇压；使崩溃；挤，把……塞进；弄皱；紧抱；捣碎，碾成粉末；破坏，毁坏；压碎；  n. 压扁；拥挤的人群；热恋，迷恋
words.example: The heavy ice crushed the wooden hull of the small ship.

words.zh: n. 水槽，洗碗池；  v. （使）下沉，（使）降低，（使）沉没；下跌；  adj. 贫民窟的
words.example: The damaged boat began to sink slowly into the freezing water.

words.zh: v. 抛弃；放弃；沉湎于（某种情感）；舍弃，废弃；  n. 尽情，放纵
words.example: The crew had to abandon the ship when it caught fire.

words.zh: n. 炉子，火炉，电炉；厨房灶具；窑；温室；  v. 在炉中烧制
words.example: They gathered around the stove to warm themselves after the storm.

words.zh: n. 毛毯；毯子；覆盖层；  adj. 总括的；全面的；综合的；  vt. 使覆盖；掩盖
words.example: A thick blanket of snow covered the camp during the night.

words.zh: n. 财物；所有物；物件；东西；动产
words.example: He packed his few belongings into a small bag before leaving.

words.zh: n. 班卓琴；五弦琴
words.example: He played a cheerful tune on his banjo by the campfire.

words.zh: adj. 痛苦的，悲惨的	；令人难受的；不快乐的，不友善的，暴躁的（人）；极少的
words.example: The wet and cold weather made the explorers feel miserable.

words.zh: n. 航海，航行；  vi. 航海；航行
words.example: The voyage across the Atlantic took more than two months.

words.zh: n. 海军；海军部队
words.example: He joined the navy after finishing high school.

words.zh: adj. 体面的，得体的；像样的；合宜的；正派的；相当不错的；穿好了衣服的
words.example: Everyone deserves a decent meal and a safe place to sleep.

words.zh: adj. 温暖而舒适的，安逸的；温馨的
words.example: The tiny cabin felt cosy and warm despite the storm outside.

words.zh: adj. 自私的
words.example: It was selfish of him to take all the food for himself.

words.zh: adj. 脾气好的；和蔼的
words.example: Despite the long delay, the good-tempered guide remained calm and friendly.

words.zh: adj. 脾气不好的，易怒的
words.example: The bad-tempered captain complained about every small mistake made by the crew.

words.zh: adj. 真正的；真的；真诚的；可信赖的；【财】真实的，真正的，诚恳的
words.example: Her genuine concern for the injured bird touched everyone in the class.

words.zh: n. 坚持不懈；毅力；韧性；不屈不挠的精神
words.example: Their perseverance in the face of hardship inspired the whole school.

words.zh: vi. 坚持，不屈不挠；孜孜以求
words.example: Even after failing twice, she decided to persevere with her experiment.

words.zh: n. 决心；坚定的信念；  v. 决定；决心；解决（问题或困难）；表决；使分解；消除；分辨，解析；【计】解析
words.example: His resolve to finish the race never faltered even when he felt exhausted.

words.zh: n. 决心，决定，坚定；决议；解决；分辨率；坚定，刚毅；【财】解决；【计】分辨率；决议，解决
words.example: The committee passed a resolution to reduce plastic waste in the school.

words.zh: n. （有专门技术的）一组工作人员，（飞机、轮船等的）全体工作人员；一群人；专业团队
words.example: The crew worked together to keep the ship safe during the violent storm.

words.zh: adj. 残忍的，残酷的；伤人的；冷酷的
words.example: It was cruel to leave the dogs outside in the freezing cold.

words.zh: adj. 彻底的，完全的；详尽的，细致的；深入的；缜密的；仔细的；【化】充分的
words.example: Before leaving the camp, the team made a thorough check of all their equipment.

words.zh: n. 家具；装置；设备
words.example: The cabin was nearly empty except for a few pieces of simple wooden furniture.

words.zh: adv. 遗憾地，可惜地，不幸地
words.example: Unfortunately, the storm destroyed the shelter they had built the night before.

words.zh: adv. 幸运地，幸亏
words.example: Fortunately, a rescue team arrived before the supplies ran out.

words.zh: vi. 狗吠，叫；  v. 厉声发令；狗吠；  n. 树皮；吠声
words.example: The dog began to bark loudly when it heard footsteps outside.

words.zh: n. 英式橄榄球；拉格比（英格兰中部的城市）
words.example: The boys practised rugby on the wet field after school every Friday.

words.zh: n. 蝙蝠；球棒，球拍；(乒乓球)拍；  v. 用球板击球；拍打（空中飞舞的小东西）；挥打
words.example: A small bat flew out of the cave as the explorers entered.

words.zh: v. 抑制；  adj. 潮湿的，有湿气的；【化】潮湿的
words.example: They hung their damp clothes near the fire to dry them quickly.

words.zh: n. 娱乐活动；消遣；游戏；重现，重建（读作/ˌriːkri'eɪʃən/）；（身心）修养
words.example: After a long day, the sailors enjoyed quiet recreation such as reading and chess.

words.zh: n. 指导，引导；导航
words.example: With the teacher's guidance, the students designed a simple experiment for class.

words.zh: n. 侄子，外甥
words.example: My nephew is learning to play the guitar and practices every evening.

words.zh: n. 广告，广告活动；广告业
words.example: The company spent too much money on advertising and little on product quality.

words.zh: v. 为……做广告；公告；公布；宣传
words.example: Local businesses often advertise in the school newsletter to reach families.

words.zh: adj. 公司的；全体的；共同的；（法人）团体的；社团的；公司的，团体的
words.example: The corporate office provided new laptops for all employees in the branch.

words.zh: v. 艰苦生活；  n. 草稿；  adj. 粗糙的；大致的，粗略的；（海）波涛汹涌的；困难的，令人不快的；粗暴的，粗鲁的；【化】粗略的；【物】粗糙的；  adv. 粗暴地
words.example: The rough sea made the small boat difficult to control.

words.zh: n. 航海家，领航员，驾驶员
words.example: The navigator studied the stars to determine the ship's exact position.

words.zh: adj. 忠心的，忠诚的；（顾客）忠实的；忠贞的；忠实的，忠诚的；  n. 忠臣
words.example: Even in hard times, the loyal dog refused to leave his master's side.

words.zh: n. 马达，发动机；车；  adj. 有引擎的；机动车的；运动神经的
words.example: The old motor suddenly stopped, leaving the boat drifting on the lake.

words.zh: n. 候选人，申请人；考生，应试者；被认定适合者；【财】候选人，应试者；候选人
words.example: She is the strongest candidate for the position of student council president.

words.zh: phr. 生火
words.example: The survival instructor showed us how to make fire without matches.

words.zh: phr. 释放
words.example: These special lamps give off a soft light that is easy on the eyes.

words.zh: n. 事件，经历；（小说的）片段；插曲；连续剧的一集
words.example: The final episode of the series left everyone waiting for the next season.

words.zh: n. 承诺，许诺；承担的义务；赞助；委托；信奉；奉献，献身；保证；投入，花费；忠诚
words.example: Her commitment to the team inspired all the players to work harder.

words.zh: n. 动机，目的；原因；  adj. 发动的，运动的；  v. 引发，促进，激发
words.example: The detective could not find any motive for the sudden disappearance of the keys.

words.zh: n. 孔子学说；儒家（学说）
words.example: Confucianism has deeply influenced the values and traditions of many Asian countries.
